title: crm.account.sale-products-linked, payload v1
description: The outcome of the involvement write (ADR-018 §5). Destination: crm.account.evt.sale-products-linked.v1. Distinct from crm.account.products-linked, which is the terminal choreography fact the LEGACY synchronous route publishes: that one says 'the sale is real', this one says 'here is how your step went'. Merging them would make a saga reply look like a terminal fact to every choreography consumer.

failureMessageKey.description: MSG-ACCT-NOT-ACTIVE if the account was passivated mid-sale, MSG-ACCT-NOT-FOUND if it vanished. A FAILED outcome here means PNDG products exist that no account claims — the orchestrator compensates them and stops.

customerNumber.description: Unused by this step; part of account-service's shared outcome shape.

productIds.description: SUCCEEDED only: the ids now linked to the account.
